Listen to an audio version of the passage in the easiest to understand translation.
In this session, retell the passage as a group in your own language.
First, the whole group should practice telling the passage in your own language. Remember
to include the things you decided in previous steps, like chronology, words, phrases,
emotions, or anything else you discussed. One group member should tell a few sentences
of the passage and pause. Another group member should tell the next part of the passage
and pause. Do this until the group has retold the whole passage. The group members can correct
each other in this step.
Pause this audio here.
Next, each member of the group
should tell the whole passage without interruption
at least one time.
A group member can use random objects, motions,
or their story board to help them remember the passage.
Pause this audio here.
Next, the group can decide who's version of the passage
you like the most.
You may decide that you like the way one group member told one scene, but you
like the way a different group member told another scene.
Pause this audio here.

agrees on. Each group member should practice telling this final version of the
passage. This is the end of the recording.
